name: 15116 · Glenshaw, PA
findings: ZIP 15116 (Glenshaw) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15116 (Glenshaw) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15116 (Glenshaw) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
